subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Do provider/security owners accept adding allowlisted GitHub Enterprise data-residency routing to the bundled github-copilot provider, including device-enterprise, COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN, githubDomain, and domain-scoped token caches?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes where provider credentials and runtime traffic may be sent and adds a provider setup/config/SDK contract, which requires maintainer/security intent before merge.

options.title: Approve bounded bundled-provider routing
options.body: Accept github.com plus single-label *.ghe.com tenant roots as the supported host-routing model for the existing github-copilot provider and land after exact-head refresh.

options.title: Narrow the exported surface first
options.body: Require the branch to keep tenant routing behind a more private provider-owned seam if maintainers do not want these helpers and config/env hooks as a public provider-auth contract.

options.title: Reject bundled-provider scope
options.body: Pause or close this PR and route enterprise-specific routing to plugin/ClawHub ownership if owners decide GHE Copilot should not live in the bundled provider.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded bundled-provider routing
recommendation.body: Accept github.com plus single-label *.ghe.com tenant roots as the supported host-routing model for the existing github-copilot provider and land after exact-head refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and have already posted the relevant maintainer-lane direction, making them the best visible decision router for the remaining owner/security acceptance.
